note: Central Italy MASAF pass 2026-11-02. Regional sheets at montagneaperte.it/patriarchiverdi (Umbrian regional list) were the second source. Register total is a count of designations, not of trees that exist.

leads.name: Plane of the former Spoleto-Norcia station
leads.reason: Regional sheet (code 74, 4.0 m, 20 m, health good) puts it in the courtyard of the old station, now a railway museum (opening hours not found, access unconfirmed). No photo or confirmed pin. MASAF says oriental plane, regional sheet says Platanus hispanica.

leads.name: Garden of Palazzo Campello (sequoia, holm oak, Corsican pine)
leads.species: Sequoia sempervirens / Quercus ilex / Pinus nigra
leads.reason: Private garden: a Spoleto heritage listing says it is privately owned and would need an agreement with the owner to open; it opens only for events such as Festival dei Due Mondi. Not public (hard rule 10).

leads.name: Stone pine and ginkgo of Hotel dei Duchi
leads.reason: Regional sheet puts the ginkgo (2.6 m, 20 m, the only big ginkgo in the Spoleto area) at the hotel entrance on Viale Matteotti, the remnant of the 17th-century Palazzo Ancaiani garden; the sheet thanks the owners for access, so street visibility is not established. Pines stand in the hotel's restaurant garden (guests). No photo or confirmed pin, access unconfirmed.

leads.name: Beeches of San Pietro in Monte
leads.reason: Five registered beeches (up to 735 cm) in a wood at 1030 m above Spoleto's far side (about 17 km); a wood, not one collectible point, not checked for photo or pin. Unverified, not pursued within the priority cluster.

leads.name: Downy oaks of Montebibico and Le Cese
leads.reason: Remote downy oaks (520 cm and 495 cm); not checked in this pass, no photo or pin evidence.
leads.write_pass_2026_11_07: stays a lead: register row only, no photo, pin, access source or dated sighting; nothing a writer can turn into a story without new research
